title: Among users who obtained at least one badge and reside in 'Vienna, Austria'
question: Among users who obtained at least one badge and reside in 'Vienna, Austria', find the percentage of their posts (created in 2010) that have a FavoriteCount greater than the average FavoriteCount of all posts made by the most influential user (i.e., the user with the highest reputation).

prediction.sql:
WITH vienna_badge_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052
    FROM users AS u
    INNER JOIN badges AS b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
    WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'Vienna, Austria'
),
most_influential_user AS (
    SELECT XCL_052
    FROM users
    ORDER BY XCL_053 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_favorite_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(p.XCL_039) AS avg_fc
    FROM posts AS p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 = (SELECT XCL_052 FROM most_influential_user)
),
vienna_posts_2010 AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_039
    FROM posts AS p
    INNER JOIN vienna_badge_users AS vbu ON p.XCL_033 = vbu.XCL_052
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2010'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN vp.XCL_039 > (SELECT avg_fc FROM avg_favorite_count) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
FROM vienna_posts_2010 AS vp;

    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
    WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'Vienna, Austria'
),
most_influential_user AS (
    SELECT XCL_052
    FROM users
    ORDER BY XCL_061 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_favorite_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(p.XCL_030) AS avg_fc
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 = (SELECT XCL_052 FROM most_influential_user)
),
vienna_posts_2010 AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_030
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN vienna_badge_users vbu ON p.XCL_033 = vbu.XCL_052
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2010'
)

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH
-- 1. Identify the most influential user (highest reputation)
most_influential_user AS (
    SELECT XCL_052 AS User_Id
    FROM users
    ORDER BY XCL_053 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- 2. Calculate the average FavoriteCount of all posts made by the most influential user
avg_fav_count_most_influential AS (
    SELECT AVG(p.XCL_030) AS Avg_Fav_Count
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 = (SELECT User_Id FROM most_influential_user)
),
-- 3. Identify users who reside in 'Vienna, Austria' and have obtained at least one badge
target_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052 AS User_Id
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
    WHERE u.XCL_059 = 'Vienna, Austria'
),
-- 4. Get the posts created in 2010 by these target users
target_posts AS (
    SELECT p.XCL_026 AS Post_Id, p.XCL_030 AS FavoriteCount
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN target_users tu ON p.XCL_033 = tu.User_Id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2010'
)
-- 5. Calculate the percentage of these posts that have a FavoriteCount greater than the average FavoriteCount of the most influential user's posts
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM target_posts tp
            WHERE tp.FavoriteCount > (SELECT Avg_Fav_Count FROM avg_fav_count_most_influential)
        ) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
    END AS Percentage
FROM target_posts
